description: Use when an agent needs to know what a URL is before reading it, or to build a link preview or citation. Input: url (public http/https). Output: JSON with final URL after redirects, HTTP status, content type, title, description, site name, language, canonical, preview image, favicon, Open Graph and Twitter tags, RSS/Atom feeds, hreflang alternates, JSON-LD types, robots, first H1. No JavaScript is run. Example: ?url=https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/ Price: $0.002 USDC via x402.

url.description: Public http(s) URL; private/internal addresses → 400 (not charged)

name: web_metadata
title: URL metadata / link preview: title, description, Open Graph, Twitter card, icons, feeds, JSON-LD
